title: beads-loop driver robustness gaps (heft generation)
description: Residual findings from 3x codereview of .opencode/plugins/beads-loop.tsx (fleet debug-trace round, 2026-08-30; fixed inline: Bun.appendSync nonexistent -> node:fs appendFileSync; bd failure returned 0 -> false 'queue drained' success, now -1 + error report). NOT fixed, pre-existing driver design: (1) no retry timer on skip/fail paths — if a round fails or completes under MIN_ROUND_INTERVAL_MS, next session.idle hits the min-interval guard and the loop silently stalls until external stimulus (trace shows this); (2) no timeout on the Bun.spawn bd-ready subprocess — a hung bd wedges running=true forever; (3) OPENCODE_BEADS_LOOP=0 or negative parses to worker 1 / short delays instead of refusing to activate; (4) drained path has no latch, re-toasts 'queue drained' on every idle; (5) appendPrompt can concatenate onto a partially typed user draft if a worker TUI is driven interactively. Relevant for the heft migration relaunch of the driver (bead bywc plugin, launch-beads-workers.sh).
notes: Addendum from re-review round: (6) trace file path is $HOME/Developer/fleet-debug.log — silently no-ops (catch{}) when ~/Developer does not exist, e.g. generic Linux hosts; homedir() fallback added, but a tmpdir fallback or one-time 'tracing disabled' report remains open. Also: sequential stdout->stderr pipe drain is a latent deadlock pattern reviewers assessed as unreachable for bd-ready output sizes (left as-is).
